questions.question: Which type of forest is the most widespread and dominant natural vegetation in India, also known as 'Monsoon Forests'?
questions.explanation: Tropical Deciduous Forests (covering ~65% of India's forested area) are the most widespread vegetation type in India, characterized by Teak, Sal, Sandalwood, and Bamboo.

questions.question: According to the Forest Survey of India (ISFR), which Indian State has the largest total geographical area under forest cover?
questions.explanation: Madhya Pradesh has the largest area under forest cover in India (77,493 sq km), followed by Arunachal Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and Maharashtra.

questions.question: Which was the first Biosphere Reserve established in India under the UNESCO Man and Biosphere (MAB) programme in 1986?
questions.explanation: Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve (established in 1986 at the tri-junction of Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Karnataka) was the first Biosphere Reserve in India, harboring Silent Valley, Nagarhole, Bandipur, and Mudumalai.

questions.question:
Match the following National Parks / Wildlife Sanctuaries with their respective States:
(A) Dachigam National Park
(B) Keibul Lamjao National Park
(C) Silent Valley National Park
(D) Simlipal National Park

(I) Manipur
(II) Kerala
(III) Jammu & Kashmir
(IV) Odisha
questions.explanation: Dachigam NP is in Jammu & Kashmir (home to endangered Hangul/Kashmir stag); Keibul Lamjao is in Manipur (only floating NP in the world on Loktak lake, home to Sangai deer); Silent Valley is in Kerala (Palakkad, Lion-tailed macaque); Simlipal NP is in Mayurbhanj, Odisha.

questions.question: Which of the following are the two officially notified Tiger Reserves located in the State of Telangana?
options: Kawal Tiger Reserve and Amrabad Tiger Reserve
questions.explanation: Telangana has two declared Tiger Reserves: Kawal Tiger Reserve (in Mancherial/Kumuram Bheem/Adilabad/Nirmal) and Amrabad Tiger Reserve (in Nagarkurnool and Nalgonda in the northern Nallamala hills).
